# GamitoFX

> GamitoFX is a Brazilian video editor and content strategist who edits long-form and short-form videos, with motion design, for English-speaking educational creators and for SaaS and app companies. Every edit starts with a written storyboard. All work is async and in writing; no calls needed.

## Services

- Long-form editing (YouTube, 16:9): talking-heads and explainers, with chapter structure, motion design and sound.
- Short-form editing (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, 9:16): hooks built for the first 3 seconds.
- SaaS and app videos: product explainers and launch videos.
- Content strategy: hooks, scripts and channel planning.
- Every client gets a custom quote.

## Clients

Brands and creators with 590K+ combined followers, including Diogo Cabral, Store Country, Cavalaria, Ella's, Taís Canatto and Dr. Wellington.
